{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    lengths = case['lengths']
    scores = case['scores']
    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(lengths)
    dp = [float('-inf')] * (budget + 1)
    dp[0] = 0.0
    chosen = [[] for _ in range(budget + 1)]
    for i in range(n):
        l = lengths[i]
        s = scores[i]
        for w in range(budget, l - 1, -1):
            if dp[w - l] != float('-inf'):
                new_score = dp[w - l] + s
                if new_score > dp[w] + 1e-12:
                    dp[w] = new_score
                    chosen[w] = chosen[w - l] + [i]
    best_w = max(range(budget + 1), key=lambda w: dp[w] if dp[w] != float('-inf') else float('-inf'))
    best_score = dp[best_w]
    return {'selected_indices': chosen[best_w], 'tokens_used': best_w, 'total_score': best_score}"}
